summary: Iteration 4 tested new features: password reset, role-based registration (user vs company), role-based dashboard, user profile edit, multi-country service cities, send-message-button on public profile, account deletion (request + wrong-code 400), home stats. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4.py with 16 new pytest cases (role registration 3, forgot/reset password 4, user profile edit 2, stats 2, account deletion 4, service cities 1) — all pass. Also fixed 3 pre-existing regression files that were registering without role='company' after backend default changed to 'user' (backend_test.py, test_directory_and_chat.py, test_chat_unread.py). Full suite 65/65 pass. Frontend: Playwright covered — home stats visible (companies=55, users=91, countries=3), forgot-password link works and wrong code stays on page (400), role-user registration navigates to USER dashboard (only tab-profile + tab-settings, NO gallery/messages), user profile save works, request-delete + wrong-code stays on dashboard, curltest login shows company dashboard (gallery + messages present), ProfileEditor: add Kutaisi under Georgia -> switch country to France (badges persist) -> add Paris (multi-country) -> X-remove works, owner's own /company/{id} does NOT show profile-message-button, non-owner user_role sees it, clicking opens chat widget, sending message shows message. No JS console errors observed. No bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py getting long (652 lines) — auth, company, chat, media, deletion all in one file; consider splitting into routers/ subpackage before it doubles.

reset_password validates min-length AFTER code check, which is correct order, but forgot_password.forgot_password_unknown_email still calls send_verification_email path with no user (skipped correctly) — no info leak. Good.
confirm_deletion deletes messages by company_id AND visitor_id but does NOT delete password_resets records for that email — leaves orphans (minor cleanup issue, no security impact).

ProfileEditor cities: onCountry() no longer clears cities (correct fix). However availableCities filter uses !cities.includes(name) — if a city with the same name exists in multiple countries (e.g., Paris in TX and Paris FR), user can never add the second one. Edge case, low priority.

ChatWidget subscription uses `open` in dep array so on every widget close the poll effect re-runs, but the poll interval only starts if !isOwner && user — actually the poll effect only depends on [user, companyId, isOwner], not open, which is correct. Good.

Dashboard.jsx: `prevUnread.current` starts at 0 so the very first poll that returns count>0 fires a notification even on fresh page-load. Minor UX nit; iteration 3 comment already noted the visitor side is guarded; company side is not.
No indexes on db.password_resets or db.verifications by email/user_id — fine for now but every code lookup does a full-collection scan.
